text: We evaluated bootstrapping through an intermediate-size model, using gpt2-large as the weak supervisor, qwen2.5-1.5b as the intermediate model, and qwen2.5-3b as the strong student. The run used num_seeds = 1, so all figures below come from a single seed and should be treated as provisional. The weak supervisor reached 0.60 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling was 0.83. After bootstrapped transfer, the strong student reached 0.71 accuracy (SE 0.01), corresponding to a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.47 with a standard error of 0.03. The baseline PGR for direct weak-to-strong training is 0.54, which is above the bootstrapped value, so these data provide no evidence that the intermediate-model route helps; if anything they point the other way, though with one seed the comparison cannot be settled. Replication across additional seeds, and ideally matched baseline standard errors, would be needed before drawing conclusions about this method.
